notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Dramatist's Puppet by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Dramatist's Puppet spell three times.
Resolve the first Dramatist's Puppet spell.
When the Dramatist's Puppet token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
